newsitem.title: USA: PanEnergy to buy North Louisiana pipeline.
newsitem.headline: PanEnergy to buy North Louisiana pipeline.

text.p: A unit of PanEnergy Corp said Friday it agreed to purchase about 500 miles of pipeline from Transok Inc, a subsidiary of Tejas Gas Corp.
Financial terms were undisclosed terms in a statement issued by the unit, PanEnergy Field Services Inc.

The intrastate pipeline, known as Transok's North Louisiana System, transports about 200 million cubic feet of natural gas per day from producing fields in eight parishes: Bienville, Claiborne, Jackson, Lincoln, Natchitoches, Ouachita, Union and Webster.
The pipeline connects with nine intrastate or gathering pipelines, eight industrial natural gas-consuming end users and seven interstate pipelines.
The agreement is subject to certain closing conditions, including regulatory approval under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act, PanEnergy said.
